answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the haven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The nectar is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the harbor.
